resources.name: DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, ABINIT, or equivalent open-source)

access.notes: Any DFT code that supports GGA-PBE and can compute optical dielectric function within the independent-particle (RPA-like) approximation. Publicly available; solver selects.
Standard PAW/NC pseudopotentials for Si, Ge, N, Ga, As.

Ideal spinel unit cell with 56 atoms. Lattice constant ~7.86–7.90 Å; atomic positions reconstructable from spinel site coordinates (Si 8a, Ge 16d, N 32e with u ≈ 0.255–0.260). Public from multiple literature sources; solver may start from literature values and relax.
